text.p: Reynolds Metals Co said Monday it will redeem on December 31 all of its outstanding seven percent PRIDES, convertible preferred stock, stated value $47.25 per share.

Upon redemption, holders will receive 0.82 Reynolds common share in exchange for each PRIDES share held plus cash for any fractional share. The PRIDES shares can be converted prior to the redemption date, Reynolds noted.

It said the number of shares deliverable upon redemption is based on a PRIDES call price of $48.077 per share and an average closing price for the common for the 15 trading days ended November 27 of $58.79 per share.
Noting there are 11 million PRIDES outstanding, Reynolds said it will issue 9,020,000 common shares as a result of the redemption. The company said it now has some 63.7 million shares outstanding.
Redemption of the PRIDES sill save more than $23.7 million in 1997 based on current dividend rates, it said.
